contentItem.title: 直线图形的外接圆
contentItem.englishTitle: A circle is said to be circumscribed about a figure when the circumference of the circle passes through each angle of the figure about which it is circumscribed.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A circle is said to be circumscribed about a figure when the circumference of the circle passes through each angle of the figure about which it is circumscribed.
据说,当圆的环形穿过所限定的图形的每个角度时,圆形就被限定为一个图形。（相关点与线段：A）
